risk_note: Risk level per ops/risk-map.yaml (identity paths, app.module.ts); funds-adjacent effects (payout accounts invalidated, withdrawal counting). Admin realname correction (BR-ID-25, CT-24q): refusals 30419 ×5 → 20001 → new ID number blocklisted 44001 (read-only match, no risk_hits) → 30407 → 30405 → the two-factor vendor, not counted against the user's daily attempts; after a match the user row is locked and in-flight withdrawals re-checked; with a succeeded withdrawal the prior identity is written to realname_prior_identities under the PRIOR_IDENTITY_* keyring, then the realname is overwritten; every bound payout account is invalidated (is_current CAS) and the first rebinding is not counted. Payout account voiding follows with B1-27g (D10-354): payout_account_changes is not written yet; switch.payout must stay off in real-money environments until B1-27g merges. user.realname_corrected queued in the same transaction; one audit row per submission past permission, step-up and body checks (refusals in their own short transaction), no plaintext in logs, audit or events. Contract operation leaves planned; generated files regenerated after rebasing onto B1-09i. Rule tests by an independent Claude (approvals #36), red before the implementation; implementation by an Opus 5.5 subagent.
